task_name: Reject chat send and retry before streaming

strengths: Both send and retry run the typed assertion after thread access, rate limiting, retry-target validation, and context checks, and before stream headers or persistence (server/src/modules/chat/message-stream.ts:33-53).
Only AgentSpendKillSwitchError is explicitly mapped to the exact 503 JSON contract; unrelated errors retain the existing logging/500 behavior (server/src/modules/chat/message-stream.ts:54-61).
The guard/error are imported from the agent module public API using the required NodeNext .js specifier (server/src/modules/chat/message-stream.ts:4-7).

HTTP tests cover enabled send/retry side-effect suppression, DB-only thread operations, default-off NDJSON/persistence, and retry 404/429/413 precedence (server/src/modules/chat/routes.test.ts:255-463).
The change is limited to the packet's two in-scope files; the handler source remains 110 lines, and no generation/helper or CRUD route implementation was changed.
